parent: SC-FUT-0005 (frozen spec sha256 90beea10e7ba88e026b1c9e440e0abb0489726193c5fca3ba2cee58379bc85e5); every trading rule is unchanged

data.exam: 2025-01-01..2026-10-21 locked; one proctor check only after Jason's OK

filter.source: NQ daily bars (GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1d, UTC days), Quant/data/databento/daily_2010-06-06_2024-12-31, equity_indexes file
filter.front: per UTC date, the NQ outright (no spreads) with the highest volume; weekend-dated bars dropped
filter.return: ln(close / previous close of the SAME contract); a contract's first bar has no return
filter.vol: V(d) = sample std (ddof 1) of the last 20 returns up to and including bar date d
filter.known_before_open: for trade date t use d* = the last bar date strictly before t (that bar ends 00:00 UTC on t, before the 08:30 CT open)
filter.high_vol_day: V(d*) > median of V over the 252 bar dates before d* (needs 252 values, always true in 2019-24 given 2010 data)
filter.artifact: brain/_system/futures/sc-fut-0006-hv-days.csv, built by scripts/build_hv_days.py before any SC-FUT-0006 result; its sha256 is recorded in the ledger at build time

rule: On high-volatility days: the SC-FUT-0005 frozen rule exactly (noise bands, HH:00/HH:30 checks, band/VWAP trailing stop, flat at 15:00 CT). Other days: no trade.
costs: L3 per contract per round trip; L1-L4 reported

benchmarks.matched_control: the SC-FUT-0005 control (same legs, random direction per leg) on the same filtered days

gates.sample_floor: at least 300 MNQ trades in practice, checked outcome-blind before results; else too few to judge
gates.workbench: vs matched control at the noise_area family's honesty-adjusted bar (this is the family's 3rd trial)
gates.prop_primary: Topstep 50K with NO max-loss lock in the Combine (brain/_system/prop/topstep_50k_nolock.json; conservative reading of the help centre checked 2026-10-27), 3 MNQ, 6-month budget, L3: first-account pass minus luck (at luck's best size) 90% range above 0 AND median trading days to pass <= 63 (3 months)
gates.prop_sensitivity: same with the original lock-at-start rules file; reported, not used for the verdict
gates.comparison_reported: SC-FUT-0005 every day at 1 MNQ on the same rules (the no-lock file), so the filter's value is visible
gates.no_retuning: the 20-day window, 252-day median, threshold and size are fixed; if it fails, no variants of the filter
